blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: You're getting famous for dancing on TikTok?
exercises.why: The imperfective деепричастие indicates an action simultaneous with the action of the predicate whether the latter is in the present, past or future: *Переписывая домашнюю работу, он делает (делал, будет делать, сделал, сделает) новые ошибки.* a) Imperfective деепричастия are formed by substituting the ending of the 3rd person plural of the present tense (-ют, -ут, -ят, -ат) with -я, or -а after ж, ч, ш, щ: читают — читая; идут — идя; говорят — говоря; служат — служа. — DLI, Lessons 100 and 102.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
